import hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path
base = Path('products/services/welfare-tender')
source = base / 'followon-rehearsal/official-notice-refresh.json'
copy = base / 'followon-acceptance/corrected-bilingual-inline-rehearsal.txt'
source_bytes = source.read_bytes()
copy_bytes = copy.read_bytes()
text = copy_bytes.decode('utf-8')
package = json.loads(source_bytes)
releases = [release for release in package['releases'] if release.get('id') == '104449-2026' and release.get('ocid') == 'ocds-h6vhtk-07971f']
lots = [lot for release in releases for lot in release.get('tender', {}).get('lots', []) if lot.get('id') == 'LOT-0000']
criteria = [(entry['name'], weight['number'], weight['weight']) for lot in lots for entry in lot['awardCriteria']['criteria'] for weight in entry['numbers']]
source_hash = hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest()
copy_hash = hashlib.sha256(copy_bytes).hexdigest()
weight_lines = [line for line in text.splitlines() if all(re.search(r'(?<!\d)' + str(weight) + r'\s*%', line) for weight in (5, 85, 10))]
checks = {'source_hash': source_hash == 'a4d2af226911f6eb8a9c1c9b618276c5ccd471bbab6ce05b8a0df6165f1c24a2', 'copy_hash': copy_hash == 'dfddd1ff667ae159ca50944102a906ea01a7d4e1a4ca9711e745d7c369b01280', 'one_matching_release_and_lot': len(releases) == len(lots) == 1, 'published_weights': sorted(criteria) == [('Price', 5, 'percentageExact'), ('Quality', 85, 'percentageExact'), ('Social Value', 10, 'percentageExact')]}
result = {'scope': 'Offline source cross-check. Read the bilingual lines in context before recording acceptance. Verify translations, detailed scoring caveats and eligibility caveats separately.', 'source_sha256': source_hash, 'rehearsal_sha256': copy_hash, 'checks': checks, 'published_criteria': criteria, 'candidate_weight_lines': weight_lines}
output = base / 'followon-acceptance/independent-lot-source-check.json'
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
